title: PromptShield
subtitle: LLM Prompt Injection Detection & Prevention Gateway
description: Full-stack security gateway analyzing prompts, assigning risk scores, and intercepting injection threats before reaching LLMs.
todoArchitecture: TODO: Add PromptShield architecture diagram to /public/images/projects/promptshield-architecture.png
highlights: Full-stack Next.js 16 / TypeScript security gateway that analyzes each prompt, assigns a 0–100 risk score, and allows, warns, sanitizes, or blocks it before it reaches the LLM.

Detects prompt injection, jailbreaks, system-prompt leaks, role override, credential probing, and tool abuse using a two-layer defense: client-side pattern guard plus server-side proxy through an OpenAI-compatible gateway (OmniRoute).
API secured with Firebase Admin ID-token verification (incl. revocation checks) and server-only credentials; dashboard modules for secured chat, playground, incidents, analytics, and audit logs.

Configurable policy engine (thresholds; allow/warn/sanitize/block actions), Firestore security rules, incident and audit logging, a programmatic analysis API, and probe / sanitization-verification scripts.
features: 0–100 Real-Time Risk Scoring Engine
Two-Layer Defense (Client Pattern Guard + Server-Side OmniRoute Proxy)
Multi-Threat Detection (Injection, Jailbreaks, System Leak, Role Override, Credential Probing)
Firebase Admin ID-Token Verification with Revocation Checks
Configurable Policy Engine (Allow, Warn, Sanitize, Block Actions)
Telemetry Dashboards: Secured Chat, Playground, Incidents, Analytics, and Audit Logs
problem: LLM integrations in modern applications are exposed to adversarial prompt injection, credential exfiltration, role overrides, and system-prompt extraction. Standard application layers lack pre-execution inspection to neutralize threats before they reach costly or sensitive upstream LLMs.
approach: Built a comprehensive full-stack Next.js 16 / TypeScript security gateway enforcing a two-layer defense: an immediate client-side pattern guard combined with an authenticated server-side proxy routing through an OpenAI-compatible gateway (OmniRoute). Configured a policy engine that evaluates multi-vector threat scores to allow, warn, sanitize, or block queries dynamically.
architecture: Full-stack Next.js 16 App Router architecture in TypeScript with Tailwind CSS. Firebase Admin SDK verifies ID tokens with strict revocation checks and server-only credentials. Requests pass through a dual inspection pipeline (pattern heuristics + server proxy) before forwarding to upstream LLMs via OmniRoute. Firestore security rules protect multi-tenant audit logs, incident reports, and real-time security analytics.

title: KrishiSaathi
subtitle: Farm-to-Market Marketplace Platform
description: Full-stack marketplace connecting farmers directly with buyers with an ARIMA price forecasting engine trained on AGMARKNET mandi data.
highlights: Full-stack marketplace connecting farmers directly with buyers (18,300+ commodity price records) with an ARIMA model trained on AGMARKNET mandi price data to forecast prices.
Hybrid Firestore and MongoDB architecture with real-time cart sync and role-based farmer and buyer dashboards.
Google, Facebook, and Apple OAuth, Razorpay payments, and 8-language commodity search; bundle size cut 69% (2.9MB to 900KB) via code splitting.

features: Real-time cart synchronization
Interactive farmer & buyer dashboards
AGMARKNET mandi price forecasting via ARIMA
Razorpay checkout flow
8-language commodity search
problem: Indian farmers lose 25–40% of revenue to middlemen in traditional mandi (market) systems. No direct-to-buyer digital platform existed that combined real-time market price intelligence with a streamlined e-commerce flow for agricultural commodities.
approach: Built a full-stack marketplace with a price-prediction engine trained on government data. Designed a hybrid database architecture combining Firestore's real-time sync with MongoDB's flexibility for complex commodity queries. Implemented role-based dashboards for farmers and buyers with multi-language search support.
architecture: Hybrid Firestore + MongoDB architecture — Firestore handles real-time cart sync and user sessions, while MongoDB manages the commodity catalog and price history. ARIMA-based price prediction model trained on 18,300+ rows of AGMARKNET government mandi data. React frontend with code-split routes, Node.js/Express API layer, Razorpay payment integration, and OAuth via Google/Facebook/Apple.

title: CineSense
subtitle: Movie Review Intelligence & Multi-Model NLP Sentiment Platform
description: Art-directed cinema intelligence dashboard and multi-model NLP sentiment classification platform evaluating Logistic Regression (89.78%), Naïve Bayes (86.90%), and PyTorch BiLSTM (83.30%) with real-time LIME token explainability.
highlights: Engineered multi-model sentiment inference benchmarking Logistic Regression (89.78% acc, 0.9634 ROC-AUC), Multinomial Naive Bayes (86.90%), and PyTorch Bidirectional LSTM (83.30%) on 10,000 held-out stratified reviews.
Integrated real-time Explainable AI using LIME feature attribution with color-coded token weights and delta scoring.
Built Letterboxd-style community reviews, personal watched diary with persistent JSON tracking, and 3x3 TMDB theatrical discovery grid.
Authored comprehensive test suite with 49 unit and integration tests across data, preprocessing, prediction, and UI services.
features: Multi-model real-time inference (Logistic Regression, Multinomial Naive Bayes, PyTorch BiLSTM)
Explainable AI token attribution via LIME with inline visual weighting
Interactive Letterboxd-style review feed with era filters (Latest 2020s vs. Golden Classics)
TMDB-powered theatrical movie explorer and personal watched diary
Corpus explorer & 4-stage lexical preprocessing pipeline audit
problem: Unstructured film reviews contain rich qualitative opinions that are challenging to quantify and synthesize manually. While baseline ML models achieve high accuracy on benchmark datasets, standard academic submissions often stop at static Jupyter notebooks without interactive inference or explainability.
approach: Engineered CineSense as an art-directed cinema intelligence dashboard merging production NLP architectures (Scikit-learn, PyTorch) with real-time LIME explainability, live TMDB film discovery, Letterboxd-style community reviews, and 49 passing automated tests.
architecture: Modular multi-tier architecture: Services layer for preprocessing, prediction, LIME explainability, TMDB integration, and review storage; UI tabs layer for Home, Movies, Analyzer, Overview, Dataset, Benchmarks, and Pipeline; and models directory hosting serialized vectorizers and PyTorch weights.

title: Brain Tumor Detection (XAI)
subtitle: Deep Learning MRI Classification with Grad-CAM Explainability
description: Multi-class brain tumor classification from axial MRI scans benchmarking Custom CNN, MobileNetV3 (93.94%), and ResNet18 (94.75% accuracy) with PyTorch Grad-CAM visual saliency maps.
highlights: Engineered multi-class convolutional neural networks in PyTorch classifying axial MRI scans into Glioma, Meningioma, Pituitary, and No Tumor.
Benchmarked Custom CNN, MobileNetV3 (93.94%), and ResNet18 (94.75% test accuracy, 0.9462 macro F1) across 1,600 balanced held-out test scans.
Implemented Gradient-weighted Class Activation Mapping (Grad-CAM) with PyTorch forward/backward hooks to produce clinical saliency heatmaps.
Deployed interactive Streamlit clinical web app for real-time MRI upload, inference, probability distribution bars, and XAI inspection.
features: Multi-model inference across ResNet18, MobileNetV3, and Custom 4-block CNN
Real-time Grad-CAM saliency heatmap generation for visual interpretability
Multi-class detection across 4 categories: Glioma, Meningioma, Pituitary, and Healthy Scans
Interactive Streamlit application with single and batch MRI upload modes
Dynamic model comparison dashboards and per-class precision/recall analysis
problem: Manual radiologist inspection of axial brain MRI scans is time-intensive and subject to inter-observer variability. Black-box deep learning systems frequently fail clinical adoption because medical practitioners cannot verify which anatomical regions drove a diagnosis.
approach: Developed an end-to-end deep learning pipeline combining transfer learning backbones with Grad-CAM visual explainability. Forward and backward hooks capture spatial activations at the final convolutional layers to generate transparent heatmaps overlaid on axial MRI scans.
architecture: PyTorch deep learning architecture: Torchvision data augmentation and normalization pipeline feeding into ResNet18 and MobileNetV3 backbones. Grad-CAM module captures final convolutional gradients via hooks and computes global average pooled weights. Streamlit frontend provides real-time model switching, file upload, inference bars, and blended heatmap overlays.
